name: Gossifleur
description: Gossifleur, the Flowering Pokémon. Able to evolve into Eldegoss. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
